

// Stage 533: actual drawer behavior, invented valuation inputs only.
const pePages=['alpha-scoreboard','opportunities'];
function peFragment(name,values){
 const html=render(name,fixture(),values);
 const match=html.match(/<span class="pe-range-context"[\s\S]*?<\/small><\/span>/);
 assert.ok(match,'Actual drawer must include the typed range renderer');return match[0];
}
test('retained predecessors reproduce false percentile labels and markup interpolation',()=>{
 for(const name of pePages){
  const ordinary=render(name,fixture(),{pe_low:10,pe_high:30,pe_pctile:25},true);assert.match(ordinary,/25th/);assert.match(ordinary,/pctile/);
  const unsafe=render(name,fixture(),{pe_low:10,pe_high:30,pe_pctile:'<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>'},true);assert.match(unsafe,/<img src=x onerror=alert\(1\)>/);
 }
});
test('actual drawers describe a range position and preserve measured zero',()=>{
 for(const name of pePages)for(const position of [0,25,100]){
  const html=peFragment(name,{pe_low:10,pe_high:30,pe_pctile:position});assert.match(html,/10–30×/);assert.ok(html.includes('position <b>'+position+'%</b>'));
  assert.match(html,/not a percentile/);assert.match(html,/window and comparability unverified/);assert.doesNotMatch(html,/th pctile|class="(?:good|bad|g|b)"/);
 }
});
test('malformed or out-of-range positions never become a number',()=>{
 for(const name of pePages)for(const value of [null,undefined,true,false,'0','25','',[],{},NaN,Infinity,-Infinity,-1,101]){
  const html=peFragment(name,{pe_low:10,pe_high:30,pe_pctile:value});assert.match(html,/position <b>unavailable<\/b>/);
 }
});
test('invalid or missing ranges are withheld and a tied range has no position',()=>{
 for(const name of pePages){
  for(const [low,high] of [[null,30],[10,null],[true,30],['10',30],[0,30],[-10,30],[30,10],[Infinity,30],[10,NaN]])assert.match(peFragment(name,{pe_low:low,pe_high:high,pe_pctile:25}),/P\/E range unavailable/);
  assert.match(peFragment(name,{pe_low:10,pe_high:10,pe_pctile:25}),/10–10×<\/b> · position <b>unavailable/);
 }
});
test('untrusted P/E fields cannot inject markup into either drawer',()=>{
 for(const name of pePages)for(const key of ['pe_low','pe_high','pe_pctile']){
  const values={pe_low:10,pe_high:30,pe_pctile:25,[key]:'"><img src=x onerror=alert(1)><script>bad()</script>'};
  const html=peFragment(name,values);assert.doesNotMatch(html,/<img|<script|onerror|bad\(\)/);assert.match(html,/unavailable/);
 }
});
test('Stage 533 preserves complete preceding page, fixture and test bytes',()=>{
 const hash=v=>require('node:crypto').createHash('sha256').update(v).digest('hex');
 const spec=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(W,'tests/fixtures/pe-range-display/preservation.json'),'utf8'));
 const oldShort=fs.readFileSync(path.join(W,'tests/fixtures/pe-range-display/previous-short-preservation.json'));assert.equal(hash(oldShort),spec.previous_manifest_sha256);
 const expectedShort=JSON.parse(oldShort);const currentShort=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(W,'tests/fixtures/short-position-display/preservation.json')));
 for(const [target,item] of Object.entries(spec.pages)){
  const raw=fs.readFileSync(path.join(W,item.predecessor));assert.equal(raw.length,item.bytes);assert.equal(hash(raw),item.predecessor_sha256);
  let expected=raw.toString('utf8');for(const [a,b] of item.edits){assert.equal(expected.split(a).length,2);expected=expected.replace(a,b);}
  assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(W,target),'utf8'),expected);assert.equal(hash(Buffer.from(expected)),item.candidate_sha256);
  assert.equal(expectedShort.pages[target].candidate_sha256,item.predecessor_sha256);
  expectedShort.pages[target].edits.push(...item.edits);expectedShort.pages[target].candidate_sha256=item.candidate_sha256;
 }
 assert.deepEqual(currentShort,expectedShort);
 const oldTest=fs.readFileSync(path.join(W,'tests/fixtures/pe-range-display/previous-short-position-display.test.js.txt'));assert.equal(hash(oldTest),spec.previous_tests_sha256);
 let expected=oldTest.toString('utf8');for(const [a,b] of spec.test_edits){assert.equal(expected.split(a).length,2);expected=expected.replace(a,b);}
 const added=fs.readFileSync(path.join(W,'tests/fixtures/pe-range-display/added-tests.js.txt'));assert.equal(hash(added),spec.added_tests_sha256);
 assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(__filename,'utf8'),expected+added.toString('utf8'));
});
